chapter: Trombonists and bandleaders across the river
title: Yank Johnson's last job with him
summary: Yank Johnson played with Valentine; his last job was at a rained-out baseball park on Good Friday.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: There's a couple of questions about some of the men across the river that you worked with. Did you ever work with Yank Johnson and Buddy Johnson?

Yeah, Yank, Yank played with me. Yank, I'm going to tell you, the last job Yank played with me, it was in the baseball park with the river. It was, it was a good Friday. Good Friday and it rained all day and all night. And we was playing that park, we were going to have a game, you know? Couldn't have the game, couldn't have the game, because it rained all day and all night. But that last job Yank played with me, yeah, Yank played with me. Yeah, he played with me.
